'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Bryan McCune LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Bryan McCune]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World|VB7-L-centeroftyranny-pre.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Bryan-Ic3b
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
